title: Puyo Puyo Sun
overview:
Here comes that guy!?

Its name: the red-hot Sun Puyo!

The long-awaited third installment!

After reading a magazine, Satan decides he wants a tan and uses his magic to make the sun bigger, turning the land into a sweltering tropical paradise. Arle and Carbuncle head for Satan's castle to put things back to normal, Schezo sets out to bring back the night, and Draco just grabs her bikini and goes sunbathing.

Stack falling Puyo and join ones of the same color to pop them, setting off chains that bury your rival in garbage Puyo. New Sun Puyo boost the damage of your attacks, so a well-timed counter can turn a match around.

- Three heroes to choose from, one for each difficulty
- Versus play for two players, with 17 characters to choose from
- Comedy cut scenes and chain voices for every character
- The familiar Tokoton Puyo Puyo mode is included

ヤツがやってきた!?

その名もあつ~い太陽ぷよ!

待ってましたの第三弾!
